description: NIST FTC-06's rim of a hole, read from STEP (split-rim-vertex step 2): the part read in place and one half of a rim circle between a plane and a cylinder filleted at r 2. The rim is two half circles between the same plane and the same cylinder; the cylinder's seam is at the first vertex (a vertex of three edges, which the chain walks through, ADR-0035) and the second carries nothing but the two arcs, a vertex of two edges where the arcs continue one another. The chain closes there as a whole ring; Arris refuses it VertexBlend (corner edges that share no face across) where Open CASCADE builds it, one blend face per arc. The file is not shrunk (ADR-0026 §4). The desired body is Open CASCADE's
